topic.title: Application UI
topic.shortdesc: This section describes the user interface. You can find here the description for each of the UI components.

body.p: The desktop application is organized into two primary screens that guide you through the workflow of joining and participating in conversations:

dlentry.dd: The entry point of the application. From here you can select an existing talk to join or create a new one. You also provide your credentials when logging in for the first time.
The main collaboration area where messages are exchanged. Participants are represented as colored circles arranged around a virtual discussion table, and messages appear as color-coded callouts.

body.p: In addition to the two main screens, a Settings panel is accessible from the toolbar at any time, allowing you to customize notifications, appearance, and network options. See for details.
